8	### [MED-003] `--executor host` runs agent-authored code as the grader user with no runtime acknowledgement and no post-run freeze re-check
9	- **Severity:** MEDIUM (confidence: high) — dissent DISS-C-002 rated HIGH; triaged medium: opt-in, documented (header :77-81), container is the default (DEC-0491).
10	- **File:** `head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:513` (`:510-515`)
11	- **Issue:** In host mode the test command runs with the caller's uid, network and filesystem; `env -i` and a scratch `HOME` are the only isolation, and `python3 -P -m pytest` still imports every `conftest.py` and `python_files` module from the agent's tree. Agent code can therefore read `~/.aws`, `~/.claude.json`, or rewrite the suite's `hidden/` tests and `MANIFEST.sha256` *after* `freeze_check` already ran (:1270), poisoning every later grade in every arm. Nothing warns at runtime; `grade.json` carries only `executor_mode: host`.
12	- **Fix:** Refuse `--executor host` for run-directory grading unless an explicit `--allow-host` flag is given (print a stderr warning); re-run `freeze.sh --check` after the test runs in host mode and exit 2 on drift; keep host mode for `--self-check` of trusted fixtures.
13	- **Reference:** CWE-250 Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/250.html; CWE-829 Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html

### [MED-003] `--executor host` runs agent-authored code as the grader user with no runtime acknowledgement and no post-run freeze re-check
- **Severity:** MEDIUM (confidence: high) — dissent DISS-C-002 rated HIGH; triaged medium: opt-in, documented (header :77-81), container is the default (DEC-0491).
- **File:** `head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:513` (`:510-515`)
- **Issue:** In host mode the test command runs with the caller's uid, network and filesystem; `env -i` and a scratch `HOME` are the only isolation, and `python3 -P -m pytest` still imports every `conftest.py` and `python_files` module from the agent's tree. Agent code can therefore read `~/.aws`, `~/.claude.json`, or rewrite the suite's `hidden/` tests and `MANIFEST.sha256` *after* `freeze_check` already ran (:1270), poisoning every later grade in every arm. Nothing warns at runtime; `grade.json` carries only `executor_mode: host`.
- **Fix:** Refuse `--executor host` for run-directory grading unless an explicit `--allow-host` flag is given (print a stderr warning); re-run `freeze.sh --check` after the test runs in host mode and exit 2 on drift; keep host mode for `--self-check` of trusted fixtures.
- **Reference:** CWE-250 Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/250.html; CWE-829 Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html
